title: Hamza Tamyachte

profile.name: Hamza Tamyachte
about: I build and maintain e-learning platforms on Moodle: plugins, course formats, integrations, reporting and the servers they run on.
In my spare time I make small web apps and games for the iPhone. They are all listed on this page, free to use and they work offline.
